acip: YI GE GSUM NI RDO RJE GSUM GYI MTSON BYED YIN LA, DE GSUM GYIS SGRIB PA GSUM SBYONG BA BZHIN DU, DBANG GSUM GYIS KYANG SBYONG BA 'DRA BA TZAM DANG, DON GYI DBANG BZHI PA RDO RJE GSUM DBYER MI PHYED PAS PHRA BA'I SGRIB PA SBYONG BA LA BSAMS NAS, SNGAR BSHAD PA'I DBANG BZHI THOB PA'I THA SNYAD BYAS PA TZAM YIN GYI, DES DBANG DNGOS THOB PA MIN NO,,
wylie: yi ge gsum ni rdo rje gsum gyi mtshon byed yin la, de gsum gyis sgrib pa gsum sbyong ba bzhin du, dbang gsum gyis kyang sbyong ba 'dra ba tsam dang, don gyi dbang bzhi pa rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pas phra ba'i sgrib pa sbyong ba la bsams nas, sngar bshad pa'i dbang bzhi thob pa'i tha snyad byas pa tsam yin gyi, des dbang dngos thob pa min no
english: The three syllables symbolize the three diamonds; these three purify you of the three obstacles.  The "three empowerments" here are similar, merely representing the same purification.  The ultimate empowerment, the fourth, is where the three diamonds, inseparable, have cleaned you of even your most subtle obstacles.  This is all that is meant when it is stated above that you "receive the four empowerments"; it's not though that by visualizing it you have actually been granted the empowerments themselves.
